Class ControllerCreateLesson

java.lang.Object
guiCreateLesson.ControllerCreateLesson
public class ControllerCreateLesson extends Object

Title: ControllerCreateLesson Class.

Description: The Create Lesson Controller. This class validates the contributor's form values, creates the lesson entity, and asks the Model to store the Lesson Details and initial Experience.

  • Method Details

    • handleCreateLesson

      protected static void handleCreateLesson(javafx.stage.Stage formStage, String author, String title, String category, String problemDescription, String solution, String timeText, String whatWasDone, String howItWasDone, String teamEffort, Runnable onCreated)

      Method: handleCreateLesson()

      Description: Validates the Create Lesson form, creates the lesson and initial Experience, reports the result, and refreshes the caller after a successful operation.

      Parameters:
      formStage - window containing the Create Lesson form
      author - username of the contributor creating the lesson
      title - lesson title entered by the contributor
      category - lesson category entered by the contributor
      problemDescription - problem or situation being documented
      solution - solution or lesson learned
      timeText - number of Experience hours entered as text
      whatWasDone - description of what was completed
      howItWasDone - description of how the work was completed
      teamEffort - description of the team's effort
      onCreated - operation used to refresh the Contributor Home page
